title: JRE 2380 - Jordan Jensen
guestBio: Jordan Jensen is a comedian, actress, and podcaster. She is the co-host of the podcast "Bein' Ian with Jordan" with comedian Ian Fidance, and host of her own podcast, "RIP Jordan Jensen." Her new comedy special, "Jordan Jensen: Take Me With You," is streaming exclusively on Netflix. Look for her in Bradley Cooper's film, "Is This Thing On?," in theaters December 19, 2025.
tldr: Jordan Jensen discusses her journey from stand-up comedy to acting and podcasting, including her Netflix special 'Take Me With You'
She talks about her comedy podcast 'RIP Jordan Jensen' and co-hosting 'Bein' Ian with Jordan' with Ian Fidance

Jordan opens up about the comedy community, networking with other comedians, and her creative process
recap:
JRE 2380 features comedian and actress Jordan Jensen, who sits down with Joe to discuss her multifaceted career spanning stand-up comedy, podcasting, and acting. Jensen has been building momentum in the entertainment space with her Netflix comedy special 'Take Me With You,' which showcases her unique comedic voice and perspective. She talks about the experience of filming a special for Netflix and how different it feels from performing live on stage night after night.

Jensen is deeply involved in the podcasting world, hosting her own show 'RIP Jordan Jensen' while also co-hosting 'Bein' Ian with Jordan' alongside comedian Ian Fidance. She breaks down how these platforms have allowed her to reach audiences in different ways and develop her voice beyond traditional stand-up comedy. The podcasting experience has become integral to how she connects with fans and explores topics more deeply than a comedy set allows.

The conversation also touches on her transition into acting, with Jensen discussing her upcoming film appearance in Bradley Cooper's 'Is This Thing On?' set to hit theaters December 19, 2025. She shares what it's like working on a film set, the differences between comedy performance and acting, and how her background in comedy informs her approach to acting roles. Jensen discusses the surreal experience of seeing herself on screen and the validation that comes with breaking into film.

Throughout the episode, Jensen and Joe dive into the comedy community, the importance of networking with other comedians, and how the industry has evolved. She talks about what drives her creatively and how she approaches different mediums. The discussion also explores the challenges of managing multiple projects simultaneously and staying focused on what matters creatively. Jensen comes across as genuine, hardworking, and genuinely passionate about her craft, whether she's making people laugh on stage, on a podcast, or on film.
